desc:
⚠️ This game is designed specifically for 2 players ⚠️

Two bees are tethered together with a honey. Your goal isn’t to fall, it's to climb. Work with your partner to swing, balance, and coordinate your way to the highest point without breaking the connection.

🧩 Movement is physics-based. You can't stick to walls, so timing and teamwork are essential.

🛠 This is an early version. You may encounter bugs - please report them through the group.

🌍 New levels are released every week.
